text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer... Thank you... so much...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: It's the Satsuki Sho! The Satsuki Sho! I've looked forward to entering a Classic race for such a long time!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, there were times I felt like
giving
up...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
High hopes or not, I knew I wouldn't be
able to
take on the Classics without a
strong enough
heart.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But then I met you, and little by little, I
overcame
my struggles. Now I've made it
here!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I was always hiding behind McQueen,
not even
seeing what was in front of me.
Now I can finally
stand on my own!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. The Nakayama 2,000-meter
track is
the right distance for me to show
what I can do.
So...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely make an impression! People
will
know that Мэдзиро Райан was here!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, aren't you the eager one? Did
you
forget that I'm here too?
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, don't count me out! I'm
ready to
dazzle you with my highly
polished starting
sprint! ♪
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
